title: Peter Thielke: January, 17, 1948 – April, 25, 2026
description: Former Homer resident, Peter (Richard) Lindsley Thielke died April 25, 2026 in Ojai, CA following a year-long battle with bile duct cancer. Peter was born January 17, 1948 in Sitka, AK, and lived in Homer for over 20 years between the late 1970’s and late 1990’s.

title: LETTER: Senator must look out for the unique needs of Alaska
description: During our 80 years in Alaska, we have seen many Territorial and U.S. senators represent Alaska. Gruening, Stevens and lately Murkowski, have seemed to understand their job was to do what was best for the country while looking out for the unique needs of Alaska. description: In this newscast: The Anchorage Assembly voted Tuesday night to have city auditors study how members have used their individual spending accounts. The study will examine spending going back to 2023 by current Assembly members as well as three who ended their terms earlier this yearl; A new mountain bike park opened in Juneau late last month. At the same time, public outcry over electric motorcycles endangering riders and chopping up trails got the attention of city leaders, who are now considering regulations; The municipal election is approaching. Eight candidates are running for three Assembly seats, and three candidates are running for two School Board seats.
